title: RoamSonio Master Knowledge Base
description: Operational documentation for Master Account functions and future pilot operations.

sections.title: PUBLISH AN EDITORIAL DESTINATION — SIMPLE STEPS
sections.purpose: A short, click-by-click checklist for preparing and publishing a destination or experience to RoamSonio Home.
howTo: 1. Open Master Account and go to Editorial Library.
2. Select the destination you want to finish. Use New Entry only when it does not already exist.
3. Check the name, type, category, seasons, activities, tagline and Build Destination. Keep the existing permanent ID when editing an entry.
4. If users should be able to start a trip from this entry, turn Buildable on and confirm Build Destination is correct.
5. Add or review its photography using the Editorial Photography steps in KB0002. Make sure the intended photo is saved and marked Approved.
6. Return to the destination details. Leave Status as Draft while anything is incomplete.
7. When the details and approved photo are ready, choose Publish and save the entry.
8. Open the RoamSonio Home page and refresh. Confirm the destination appears with the right photo and opens the expected destination/trip-builder path.
9. If it does not appear or something looks wrong, do not keep changing unrelated settings. Record the issue and ask for help.
safety: Never create a duplicate entry just because an existing destination needs editing.
Do not change the permanent ID of an existing destination.
Do not edit existing saved trip records from the Editorial Library; publishing must not change a user's saved trip.
A destination should be published only after its content and intended photography are ready.
The weekly Home Edit uses eligible published entries; publishing does not guarantee every entry appears immediately in the current week's rotation.
Test the published entry on Home before calling it complete.

sections.title: Editorial Photography
sections.purpose: Maintain controlled, high-quality destination photography for the luxury travel-magazine presentation.
howTo: 1. In Master Account, open Editorial Library and select the destination.
2. Open its Editorial Photography area and choose Add Photo.
3. Choose a suitable candidate or enter the image details.
4. Check the image preview. Confirm the role (Hero, Secondary or Mobile), source URL, photographer credit and alt text are correct.
5. Mark Approved only when the image is suitable and the source/credit are recorded.
6. Choose Save Photo. Reopen or refresh the photo list and confirm the saved photo is still there.
7. Return to KB0001 and publish the destination only when its content and photography are ready.
safety: Do not replace existing trip photos through this library.
Do not mark a photo Approved before reviewing it.
Keep source URL and photographer credit with every approved image.
Saving a photo and publishing a destination are two separate actions.

sections.title: WEEKLY SUGGESTIONS & HOMEPAGE ROTATION
sections.purpose: Explain how weekly private suggestion generation, human approval into the permanent Editorial Library, and stable Sunday homepage rotation work together.
howTo: 1. Every Sunday, the Weekly RoamSonio Editorial Suggestions workflow is scheduled for 9:00 AM Eastern. It checks the curated idea pool against existing Editorial Library entries and selects up to three unused ideas for this week's private Master Inbox.

2. The generator creates draft records only. It does not approve photos, publish destinations, edit existing destination records, or modify saved trips. If all curated ideas already exist, the workflow can report zero new drafts; expand the curated idea pool when that happens.

3. The photo-preparation workflow runs every 30 minutes, with overlapping runs prevented, so new and waiting drafts can receive photo candidates over time. Candidates remain unapproved and require visual review.

4. Open Master Account → Suggestion Inbox to review the new drafts. Check for duplicates, verify destination/activity details, review the Hero, Secondary and Mobile photos, and use the retry controls only when needed. The retry cooldown is 30 minutes per destination.

5. To add a suggestion permanently to Master, finish its details and photography, then explicitly approve the required photo set and publish the destination. Publishing moves the entry into the permanent Editorial Library; merely generating a draft does not.

6. The public Home page reads published Editorial Library entries with approved HTTPS photography. It rotates its displayed selection by the week, anchored to the Eastern calendar date, and does not randomly change the selection on every page refresh.

7. A newly published entry may be eligible for the next weekly rotation rather than appearing in the current edition. After publication, refresh Master status and Home/Weekly Homepage preview and confirm the entry and photo display correctly.

8. If the weekly workflow does not run, open GitHub Actions → Weekly RoamSonio Editorial Suggestions and inspect the latest run and logs. Photo preparation runs every 30 minutes without overlapping runs. Use Run workflow only for a deliberate manual test; do not repeatedly dispatch it to force new drafts.
safety: Weekly generation creates drafts only. Human Master Admin review is required before a suggestion joins the permanent Editorial Library.
Weekly homepage rotation and weekly draft generation are separate workflows: one adds review candidates, the other selects from published, approved library entries.
Do not hard-code weekly destinations in index.html or show unapproved drafts on the public Home page.
Do not create duplicates or change permanent IDs to make an entry appear new.
Do not edit existing saved trip records, trip IDs, or snapshots as part of editorial generation, approval, or rotation.
Keep photo approval separate from destination publication; always inspect actual images, credits, source URLs, and alt text.
If the curated idea pool is exhausted, add researched new ideas to the generator pool and check duplicates before relying on the next weekly run.

sections.title: Build From Inspiration
sections.purpose: Allow a user to turn an editorial destination, region or experience into a new trip without changing existing saved trips.
howTo: Use Build This Journey from an eligible editorial entry.
Pass the stable editorial/build destination into the existing builder.
Let the existing builder create the new trip.
safety: Never overwrite an existing trip.
Never reuse an existing saved trip ID for an editorial entry.
Test the complete build-and-save flow before approval.

sections.title: Versioning & Rollback
sections.purpose: Protect tested production states and provide a controlled rollback path.
howTo: Register every development version.
Keep untested work in TESTING.
After user confirmation, mark the exact tested version SUCCESS and rollback eligible.
Mark broken work ISSUE or FAILED and never make it a rollback target.
safety: Administrative registry commits are not production rollback targets.
Do not mark a version SUCCESS before user testing.
Make one focused change at a time when possible.

sections.title: Pilot Readiness
sections.purpose: Prepare the site for real users without destabilizing existing trips.
howTo: Review each page individually.
Test core user journeys after meaningful changes.
Verify existing trips remain accessible and persistent.
Separate must-fix issues from optional polish.
safety: No broad redesign should bypass a test point.
Existing trip data, IDs, persistence and routing are protected requirements.

sections.title: ADD, REFRESH & APPROVE SUGGESTIONS
sections.purpose: Operate the Suggestion Inbox and Suggestion Studio, retry missing editorial photography safely, and publish only after a human review.
howTo: 1. Sign in as Master Admin and complete MFA. Open Master Control → Editorial Library → Suggestion Inbox. Use Suggestion Studio for editing the destination details and individual photo records.

2. To add a new idea, open Suggestion Studio and create a New Entry only if the destination, region or activity does not already exist. Give it a clear name, type/category, build destination, tagline, seasons and activities. Save it as Draft while work remains. Edit the existing entry rather than making a duplicate.

3. In Suggestion Inbox, use Drafts and the search field to find the entry. Batch Photo Review shows Hero, Secondary and Mobile coverage. Select Open details to inspect the roles, or Review photos/Open Suggestion Studio to search for candidates, manually replace a picture, and save the selected image.

4. For each photo, visually confirm that it depicts the intended place or experience. Confirm the role is correct (Hero, Secondary or Mobile), the image URL and source URL use HTTPS, and credit and descriptive alt text are present. Save the photo, then reload the status or reopen the entry to verify it persisted.

5. If photo roles are missing, use Retry photos on that destination. To queue multiple incomplete drafts, use Queue missing photos and confirm. These actions only queue photo preparation; they do not approve images or publish suggestions.

6. After triggering a retry, the button displays a countdown and remains locked for 30 minutes for that destination to prevent repeated pushes. Queue missing photos skips destinations already queued or in cooldown. Do not repeatedly click Retry photos. The scheduled photo-preparation workflow checks queued work automatically; allow time for the next cycle and for Wikimedia rate limits.

7. Use Reload status after the automatic cycle to refresh the Inbox display. Check the role count and preparation status again. A candidate being attached or a draft being marked ready is not proof the image is correct; open Suggestion Studio and inspect it. If no good match is found, use manual search/replacement or leave it in Draft for later review.

8. Publish only when the destination details are complete and all three required photo roles are present, visually reviewed, and have source URL, credit and alt text. In the Inbox, use Approve photos + publish and confirm the prompt. This approves the three photo records and publishes the editorial entry to the permanent Editorial Library.

9. After publication, return to Master Control and refresh the Editorial Library/Home preview. Confirm the entry is published and its images look correct. Homepage eligibility follows the next-Sunday Eastern boundary shown by the workflow; publication does not guarantee the entry appears in the current edition immediately.
safety: Drafts remain private; no photo retry, queue action, image attachment, or refresh automatically approves or publishes anything.
Always visually review the actual images. Automated matching uses metadata/search relevance and can still choose a wrong or weak image.
Do not repeatedly trigger retries during the 30-minute cooldown. The timer is per destination; a refresh should not clear it because its expiry is stored in destination metadata.
If the status is Needs attention or no suitable photo is found, do not force approval. Manually search/replace or leave the draft pending.
Do not change permanent destination IDs, edit existing saved trips, or modify trip snapshots during editorial work.
Approval and publication require the Master Admin + MFA session. Photo approval and destination publication are distinct from merely saving a candidate.
If the site does not reflect a confirmed publication, reload the status and check the destination record before making unrelated changes.
